en: "I was sure I sensed an enemy, thouugh?"
"But I sense something eerie. Not{n} a soldier, at least. It's a bit different{n} from the bloodlust a person gives off."
"You remember me, of course?{n} Yes, I'm Diane, your little sister."
"It hurt so much. I bled and bled.{n} But look at me, reborn. I made it{n} back to this world, Brother."
"Hee hee, don't be so frightened.{n} After I died, I understood it all."
"You were in love with me, Brother.{n} With me, your own sister by blood.{n} You came to love me as a woman."
"After I died, I understood it all.{n} You told me Bentley, my lover,{n} had died on the battlefield."
"The truth is you killed him, right?{n} You resented what Bentley and I had,{n} so you killed him out there, yes?"
"Hold me as much as you like."
"But... there's just one lie...{n} ...That's right... no matter what...{n} the dead... do not speak..."
"You'd kill me a second time, Brother!?"
"You're there... aren't you, Raggadol...{n} ...Isn't it about time... you showed{n} yourself... in front of me...?"
"As expected of the Battlefield{n} Executioner. Well done,{n} detecting my presence..."
"Raggadol, wielder of the dead...{n} So you... came to this island too."
"Even you... dried up... like some{n} mummy... want the Almighty Treasure{n} ...that sleeps on this island?"
"I have mastered the dark arts and{n} already lived for centuries.{n} I have no interest in such a thing..."
"Corpses lie strewn all over it.{n} I pick out the parts I fancy and{n} make any zombie I please."
"Oh yes, even a zombie that looks{n} just like your sister, or a skeleton..."
"I paid high prices for the corpses{n} you made, and with that money your{n} sister was spared from being sold..."
"And you would kill that benefactor?{n} Kill me with that knife,{n} as you killed your sister?"
"So you led her to the rebel army{n} and arranged for her to face me{n} on that wasteland battlefield."
"Those killed by their own kin leave{n} bitter regret behind in this world.{n} Such dead make fine zombies."
"She was a good one, your sister."
"Even in my collection, she turned{n} out one of my finest works,{n} among the top five..."
"All thanks to you killing your{n} beloved sister Diane{n} with your own hands."
"That's why... I'll kill you...{n} After I kill you... I'll die too."
"If you wish to die, die as you please.{n} I need your help no longer.{n} I shall not want for corpses now."
"Not on this island alone: on the{n} continent, the third great war that{n} I can remember has broken out..."
"I shall not want for corpses now."
"You mean to kill me with that...?"
"A hundred years ago, a certain knight{n} very nearly sealed me away for good..."
"Yet even so, I plied the dark arts{n} and came back to life like this.{n} You cannot kill me. Not with this..."
"Sorry... Diane...{n} ...I can't die... of a wound like this.{n} I still... haven't killed that one."
"My name... is Jaguar...{n} ...But... the army lot...{n} call me... this..."
"J... is the J in Judgment.{n} ...What I hand down in battle...{n} is always... a death sentence."
"Uoh... oh... it hurts...?{n} ...I, who have... an undying body...{n} feel... the pain of death...?"
"This... is my verdict on you...{n} ...Listen well... with those...{n} shriveled ears... Raggadol..."
"...The dark power... is running out?{n} Is this... the limit of the art?{n} ...Was eternal life... an illusion?"
"I was not... killed by you.{n} ...It is the limit... of my own art...{n} the limit of a body... centuries old..."
"The death sentence... is passed...{n} ...Hurry back... to your grave,{n} you black... monster of magic..."
"Ah... aaah... the Almighty Treasure...{n} If only the Almighty Treasure...{n} were in my hands..."
"It's been a long journey... but at{n} last... I think I can come... to{n} where you are... Diane..."
"This is... the last sentence I pass...{n} ...The last condemned... to be judged{n} by this... knife... is myself..."
"Honestly! Don't 'you' me like that!{n} Why would you try to kill yourself!?"
"No! Absolutely nooot!{n} If your sister were alive,{n} she'd stop you too, I'm suuure!"
"That doesn't add up, {name:6}.{n} If his sister were alive, this guy{n} wouldn't be thinking of dying, right?"
"Th-that may be sooo!{n} But killing yourself is something{n} you must never, ever dooo!"
"In this world there are lots and{n} lots of people who wanted to live{n} and couldn't, you knooow!"
"But... I've killed a lot of people."
"Then live for their share too!{n} Suffer for as long as you live!{n} That is how you atone for your sins!"
"Leave it, {name:6}. He means it.{n} If a guy wants to die, let him die."
"This world's got too many people{n} as it is. A guy like him staying alive{n} only burdens those who want to live."
"All right. But please think it over."
"If you die here, your sister is just{n} the sister of a murderer.{n} Are you really fine with thaat?"
"Then what would you have me do?"
"Keep traveling with me.{n} And we'll seal the Almighty Treasure."
"Do that, and your sister will be{n} remembered by everyone..."
"...as the sister of the hero{n} who saved the world from ruin."
"No, you mustn't!{n} Killing your own self is{n} nothing but running away!"
"You are just a little coward!{n} A coward with no courage to go on{n} living, who only ever runs awaay!"
"You seem... to be persuading me...{n} ...but your logic... is nonsense.{n} It doesn't... add up at all..."
"My sister too... would say wild{n} things like that... and give me{n} no end of trouble..."
"I'll put off dying... a little longer..."
"Don't worry about it. Just like you{n} wanted, he's thought better of dying."
"I see. A pack of zombies.{n} No wonder it didn't feel human."
"Could these be ancient zombies{n} guarding the island of steel, tooo?"
"Can't say, but hundreds, thousands{n} have already died on this island."
"Zombies, ghosts, whatever shows up{n} and whenever, it wouldn't be{n} the least bit strange."
"This is no time to be scared.{n} Whoever stands in our way is{n} an enemy. Let's clean them up fast!"
"We have no choice but to fight!"
"Looks like we cleaned them up somehow."
"It's all thanks to your splendid{n} commaand, Mr. {hero:6}!"
"Whew, that gave us a lot of trouuble."
"Hmph. If you're a leader too, try{n} commanding a little more properly.{n} You're so shaky I can't bear to watch."
"I'm in your debt... Go on ahead."
"Like I said, what do you meean?"
"Don't ask. If you carry a sword too,{n} you must have seen the resolve{n} and the hatred in his eyes."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."
"...Thunder wind, become a blade raging{n} in the air, and show the horde{n} writhing on the ground your true power..."
"...Absolute ice, become storm fangs{n} that shake heaven and earth, and show{n} the oncoming malice your true power..."
"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"
"Come, dragon, dragon of the earth!{n} Open, Gate of Death! Lead on to hell!"
"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
